event:acquisitions_and_disposals.label: Stake acquired in WestJet
event:acquisitions_and_disposals.note: Air France-KLM completed the acquisition of a minority stake in Canadian airline WestJet, bought from its joint venture partner Delta Air Lines. Quote (page 18): "On October 22, 2025, Air France-KLM finalized the acquisition of a 2.3% stake in the capital of Canadian airline WestJet for a total amount of $49 million. This transaction, initially announced on May 9, 2025, remained subject to certain approvals."

event:funding_and_rating.label: Bond issuance under EMTN programme
event:funding_and_rating.note: The Group placed senior unsecured bonds under its EMTN programme, with the cash received in September 2025. Quote (page 18): "bonds on August 28, 2025, with a maturity of 5 years and a coupon of 3.75% (yield of 3.866%) under its EMTN program. The cash inflow occurred on September 4, 2025 (see Note 31 “Financial liabilities”)."

event:funding_and_rating-2.label: Redemption of convertible subordinated perpetual bonds
event:funding_and_rating-2.note: The Group notified holders of its last-rank indefinite subordinated convertible bonds of its intention to redeem all outstanding hybrid bonds from the hard call date, and paid the nominal amount plus accrued interest in November 2025. Quote (page 18): "On October 15, Air France–KLM Group notified the holders of last-rank indefinite subordinated bond convertible into new shares and/or existing shares its intention to redeem all of the outstanding hybrid Bonds from the First Hard Call Date at a price per hybrid Bonds equal to par (€100,000) plus accrued interest of 1,625 euro."

event:funding_and_rating-3.label: Credit facility maturity extended
event:funding_and_rating-3.note: The Group exercised an extension option on the Air France-KLM and Air France credit facility, pushing its maturity date out. Quote (page 17): "This last extension option was exercised in June 2025, bringing the maturity date to 2029."

event:funding_and_rating-4.note: The Group issued new perpetual bonds and repaid existing perpetual bonds during the year. Quote (page 8): "Issuance of perpetual 28.3 494 – Repayment of perpetual 28.3 (802) –"
